svg.text: WEB DEVELOPER PRICING SYSTEM · CURRENT EDITION
Treat the unknown before deciding who should carry it.

g.text: QUESTION
COMMERCIAL RESPONSE
Can the unknown be verified cheaply before commitment?
Inspect, test, ask, or obtain access first.
Do not charge the client for uncertainty you can cheaply remove.
Can the variation be bounded with a clear assumption?
Record the assumption and the consequence if it fails.
A fixed commitment may still fit if the remaining variation is controlled.
Is discovery itself a useful standalone engagement?
Sell bounded paid discovery before implementation.
The discovery output must remain useful even if the later build changes hands.
Must the work evolve while the unknown is being resolved?
Use T&M, capped T&M, or a hybrid structure.
The model should match how uncertainty can actually be managed.
Does the work create a real continuing obligation?
Use a recurring structure only when recurring value and responsibility exist.
Occasional future work is not automatically a retainer.
Is the uncertainty too consequential or cooperation too weak?
Reshape, defer, or decline the commitment.
The system does not require every opportunity to become a quote.
Pricing Model is a risk-allocation decision.
Fixed price is not inherently more professional.
T&M is not automatically less disciplined.
Paid discovery is justified only when it produces a useful bounded output.
The structure should change when the evidence changes.
Do not hide a material unknown inside a confident-looking fixed number.

svg.text: Current-edition decision logic recreated as vector text for a legible product-page proof.
